root_causes.description: Flux exceptions indicate significant variances in financial data, suggesting inadequate review processes or missing documentation.
root_causes.financial_impact: $59,012.22 in auto journals created, potentially linked to unreviewed flux variances.

remediations.action: Implement enhanced flux review procedures, including variance thresholds and mandatory documentation for significant changes.
remediations.estimated_effort: 2 weeks with 1 FTE for process design and training.
remediations.success_criteria: Reduction in flux exceptions by 80% in the next financial close cycle.
